findings.finding: The 65 shared path deltas are identical, excluding index object hashes. Production alone additionally updates 2 publicNetwork locale files; there is no demo-only path.

Production delta is not directly applicable to the candidate. Per-path read-only apply checks fail for 24 paths. Do not cherry-pick a release parent, copy whole parents, or overwrite candidate files from the released tree.

New FeedClipsRail accesses routes.clips, absent from candidate EngineRoutes. The new source does not compile unchanged against the candidate contract. It deliberately renders nothing without an injected destination; preserving the published behavior additionally requires the real clips destination and its dependencies, beyond the 67-path delta.

Published PeoplePanel, ProfilPersonnePage and SuggestionsPanel already depend on the shared useConnectionRequest hook in their parent version. Candidate lacks the hook. Copying whole released component blobs implicitly imports this non-social-delta base and its new backend argument contract. Apply only selected social hunks to candidate, or explicitly include the bounded prerequisite chain; do not assume the absence of backend files in the social commit means no backend dependency.

findings.finding: offer-experience-styles.ts is modified, not added, in the social commit, but absent from candidate. New imports from member-shop-directory and public-storefront-card require SHOP_ACTION_CLASS. Released offer-card also imports existing OFFER_DETAIL_CSS from the same base. Its small prior OFFER_DETAIL_CSS definition is a bounded prerequisite if bringing this module, not grounds for copying the whole commerce parent tree.

Theme runtime delta is narrow: declare --esp-social-action-radius: initial in charte.css and 8px in each of seven ANTSIA themes. Those files have other parent changes, so full blob copying would pull unrelated geometry. antsia-reference-layout.test.ts is modified by a single additional token assertion but absent from candidate; its released full test additionally asserts the prior 60-board layout geometry. It is not safe to treat its whole content as the social delta alone.

findings.finding: Production-only publicNetwork deltas refine two text values per locale: legal.sections.publication.body (certification -> official validation wording) and legal.privacy.recipients.body (Vercel hosting -> infrastructure wording). They apply on top of the candidate privacy-approved content. They are absent from demo social delta, so preserve them deliberately if aligning to latest production. No new legal page source changed in this commit.

No convex/, package manifest, lockfile or environment file is directly changed by either social commit. New social-action-style.ts and notifications-styles.ts are self-contained additions included in the 67 paths; their absence from candidate is expected, not an external prerequisite. Candidate already has Avatar.shape, PostMediaDto, POST_SURFACE_STYLE and viewer-preferences export.
